typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Lead_ID as string,
		Customer_ID as string,
		Promotion_ID as string,
		Title as string,
		First_Name as string,
		Middle_Initial as string,
		Last_Name as string,
		Suffix as string,
		Gender as string,
		Birthdate as string,
		Address_1 as string,
		Address_2 as string,
		City as string,
		State as string,
		Zip as string,
		County as string,
		Phone as string,
		Do_Not_Call as string,
		Email_Address as string,
		Email_Opt_Out as string,
		Toll_Free_Number_Called as string,
		Time_of_Call as string,
		Date_of_Call as string,
		Call_Disposition as string,
		Plan_Effective_Date as string,
		FILE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/ib_mscc_referral*']) ~> source1
source(output(
		RecordTypeId as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/mscc_referral_record_type_id.csv']) ~> RecordTypeId
Select1, RecordTypeId join(1 == 1,
	joinType:'left',
	matchType:'exact',
	ignoreSpaces: false,
	broadcast: 'right')~> Join1
DerivedColumn1 select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Lead_ID__c = Lead_ID,
		Customer_Agility_Id__c = Customer_ID,
		Promo_ID__c = Promotion_ID,
		Salutation__c = Title,
		First_Name__c = First_Name,
		Middle_Name__c = Middle_Initial,
		Last_Name__c = Last_Name,
		Suffix__c = Suffix,
		Gender__c = Gender,
		Birthdate__c = Birthdate,
		Other_Street_1__c = Address_1,
		Other_Street_2__c = Address_2,
		Other_City__c = City,
		Other_State__c = State,
		Other_Postal_Code__c = Zip,
		County__c = County,
		Home_Phone__c = Phone,
		Do_Not_Call__c = Do_Not_Call,
		Email__c = Email_Address,
		HasOptedOutOfEmail__c,
		Toll_Free_Number_Called__c = Toll_Free_Number_Called,
		Call_Time__c = Time_of_Call,
		Call_Date__c = Date_of_Call,
		Call_Disposition__c = Call_Disposition,
		Plan_Effective_Date__c = Plan_Effective_Date
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
ConditionalSplit1@Insert derive(Birthdate = toTimestamp(Birthdate, 'yyyyMMdd'),
		Gender = iif(Gender=="M","Male",iif(Gender=="F","Female",iif(Gender=="U","Undeclared",''))),
		HasOptedOutOfEmail__c = iif(upper(Email_Opt_Out)=='Y','true','false'),
		Do_Not_Call = iif(upper(Do_Not_Call)=='Y','true','false')) ~> DerivedColumn1
source1 derive(ADFId__c = uuid()) ~> ADFId
ADFId split(isNull(Lead_ID)||isNull(Promotion_ID)||isNull(First_Name)||isNull(Last_Name)||isNull(Gender)||isNull(Birthdate)||isNull(Address_1)||isNull(State)||isNull(Zip)||isNull(Phone)||isNull(Email_Address),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(Reject, Insert)
ConditionalSplit1@Reject derive(REJECT_REASON = concat('ADF:Field contain NULL value: ', iif(isNull(Lead_ID), '{Lead ID} ', ''), iif(isNull(Promotion_ID), '{Event ID} ', ''), iif(isNull(First_Name), '{First Name} ', ''), iif(isNull(Last_Name), '{Last Name} ', ''), iif(isNull(Gender), 'Gender ', ''), iif(isNull(Birthdate), 'Birthdate ', ''), iif(isNull(Address_1), '{Address 1} ', ''), iif(isNull(City), 'City ', ''), iif(isNull(State), 'State ', ''), iif(isNull(Zip), 'Zip ', ''), iif(isNull(Phone), 'Phone ', ''), iif(isNull(Email_Address), '{Email Address} ', ''))) ~> rejectReason
rejectReason select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select2
Join1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_mscc_referral_Staging_Inbound_Campaign__c.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> toInsert
ADFId sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_mscc_referral_raw.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> curatedRaw
Select2 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_mscc_referral_source_reject.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> toReject
